sentences.text:
Nemi Chandra vs Nagar Swasth Adhikari And Another on 22
August, 2019

Author: Sudhir Agarwal
Bench: Sudhir Agarwal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 34

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 1643 of 1995
Revisionist :- Nemi Chandra

Opposite Party :- Nagar Swasth Adhikari And Another
Counsel for Revisionist :- Tej Pal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt.Advt.
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.
2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by the judgments and orders dated 11.03.1995 and 17.11.1995.

The First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Agra vide order dated 11.03.1995 convicted revisionist and sentenced him to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/- under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text: First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Agra
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thereagainst, revisionist preferred Criminal Appeal No. 40 of 1995 and Appellate Court vide judgment and order dated 17.11.1995 dismissed appeal and confirmed order of conviction and sentence passed by Trial Court.
Being aggrieved the revisionist preferred present revision.
